mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, contract_project_id, artifact_classification_id, pricing_manner, process, measurement_manner
mapper.select: SELECT mcpawcl.*, ssc.classification_name as artifact_type_name, mbp.id AS process_id, mbp.name AS process_name FROM mes_contract_project_assembling_welding_config_link mcpawcl LEFT JOIN sys_structure_classification ssc on ssc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE and ssc.id = mcpawcl.artifact_type_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON FIND_IN_SET(mbp.id, mcpawcl.process) > 0 WHERE mcpawcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mcpawcl.contract_project_id = #{projectId}
SELECT count(0) FROM mes_contract_project_assembling_welding_config_link mcpawcl WHERE mcpawcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mcpawcl.contract_project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT mcpawcl.*, ssc.classification_name as artifact_type_name, mbp.id AS process_id, mbp.name AS process_name FROM mes_contract_project_assembling_welding_config_link mcpawcl LEFT JOIN sys_structure_classification ssc on ssc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE and ssc.id = mcpawcl.artifact_type_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON FIND_IN_SET(mbp.id, mcpawcl.process) > 0 WHERE mcpawcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mcpawcl.id = #{id}
